facts: Ammonia oxidation takes place in MeCN. The computational models use pyridine axial ligands; the experimental catalysts use NH3 ligands. The neutral bda and bcs catalyst frameworks contain one Ru, one dianionic bipyridyl ligand and two pyridines. Adding one N gives the local nitrogen-containing composition with net charge +1. Net charge defines electron inventory; coordination, spin, bonding and electronic assignments are to be established. NH3 is the incoming reagent. The temperature is 298.15 K. Redox conditions are 0.50 V versus Fc+/0 and a MeCN pH reference of 15.1, which are distinct from chemical activation barriers.
scope: The Ru–bda–Py local nitrogen composition is the target. The Ru–bcs–Py analogue is available for a justified comparison. A full electrocatalytic cycle, device performance, turnover frequency or global rate-determining step is outside scope.
